🚨🇺🇸 WHY TRUMP PICKED HEGSETH TO CLEAN UP THE PENTAGON
Critics often freak out over Hegseth’s lack of traditional credentials, but his resume isn’t exactly light.
He’s got 21 years of military service with combat leadership in Iraq and Afghanistan—earning two Bronze Stars for actual battlefield decisions, not desk work. 
Plus, he ran Concerned Veterans for America, managing a $16 million budget and expanding its reach.
Hegseth’s focus? Cutting Pentagon bloat, boosting combat readiness, and fixing recruitment and morale. 
Whether you like him or not, he’s not here to protect the status quo.
Source: texaspolicy
